memory-personal-empty-description: Add a stable preference or fact above when you want Eigent to remember it across your work.
memory-personal-use-description: Include these personal notes in future Agent context.
memory-reconciliation-description: Eigent did not overwrite either version. Choose which content to keep for each item.

memory-select-scope-description: Select a {{scope}} to manage its Memory.
memory-session-auto-description: Automatically learn explicit stable details as this Session runs. You can edit or archive them here at any time.
memory-session-collection-description: Review, confirm, and manage the stable notes saved for this Session.
memory-session-composer-placeholder: Add a decision, constraint, preference, or fact for this Session
memory-session-description: Eigent can learn a small set of stable notes from this Session. These notes stay with the Session and are separate from its full task history.
memory-session-empty-description: Add a note above, or turn on Auto Memory so Eigent can learn stable details as this Session runs.
memory-session-use-description: Include these notes in future Agent context for this Session.
memory-space-auto-description: Automatically learn explicit Space-wide facts, decisions, and preferences from Sessions in this Space. You can edit or archive them here at any time.
memory-space-collection-description: Only notes saved here are shared. Session Memory remains inside its Session.
memory-space-composer-placeholder: Add a decision, constraint, preference, or fact to share across this Space
memory-space-description: Eigent can learn stable notes explicitly meant for this Space and reuse them across its Sessions. Session-specific notes remain in their Session.
memory-space-empty-description: Add a stable note above when you want every Session in this Space to remember it.
memory-space-use-description: Include these shared notes in future Agent context for Sessions in this Space.

memory-sync-empty: Up to date — no saved notes to sync yet
